Terms and conditions

The rules of the game, written simply. They apply to all services, together with the order summary.

1. Purpose

These terms apply to any order placed with Les Minis Monstres: creation of a website, options, monthly plans and related services. They complement the order summary, which specifies the website, the option chosen, the plan or website only, and the prices.

2. Ordering online

Ordering takes place on the website, in three steps: putting the website together, entering contact details, then secure payment. To put their website together, the client sees, in order: the website, the online shop option, then the choice of who puts it online. They leave it to Les Minis Monstres with a monthly plan (“We take care of everything”), or they handle it themselves (“I will handle it myself”, the website only option). If they pick a plan, they then choose their domain name and which of the two plans they want. The total is shown last, with the choice of paying the rest in one go or in several instalments (article 5). Before paying, the client sees a full summary, with the amount paid that same day and the amounts to follow. If they have an event code (article 4) or a referral code (article 17), they enter it during the order.

By clicking "Order and pay", the client accepts these terms and places a firm order. They immediately receive a confirmation email with an order reference, to quote in all correspondence.

An order can also be placed by email or by message. It is then firm when the client accepts the summary in writing and makes the first payment.

3. Prices

Prices are in euros. VAT is not applicable (article 293 B of the French General Tax Code) as long as the business qualifies for the VAT exemption. If this changes, the displayed prices are updated. Orders already placed keep their price.

The offer is the same for all clients. It comes in two parts: the creation of the website, paid once, then the choice of who puts the website online and keeps it running. With a monthly plan, paid for as long as the website is hosted by Les Minis Monstres, everything is taken care of. With website only, the client takes care of it themselves.

Creating the website costs €500. This price corresponds to the “Professional Website”. It includes up to 15 pages, a custom design, a display suited to phones and computers, a contact form, a Google map, basic Google SEO and personalised support from Alex and Les Minis Monstres. Search engine optimisation, also called SEO, means what helps a website be found more easily on Google.

Domain name and hosting. The domain name is the website’s address. Hosting is the service that keeps the website available 24 hours a day. With a monthly plan, Les Minis Monstres installs the website and puts it online, and both are free for the first year, except for a website with an online shop. After that, the plan covers them (article 6). With website only, the client manages their own domain name and hosting.

SEO pages. The pages the client does not use, out of the 15 included, can become SEO pages. Each one answers a search made by the client’s own customers on Google, to make the website more visible. For example, a client who uses 8 pages to present their business keeps 7 pages to improve their presence on Google.

The options are paid once, on top of the creation price, and none of them is required. When ordering, there is one:

  • Online shop, €200: a product catalogue, a basket, online payment, order management and emails sent automatically to buyers. With the shop, the creation costs €700.

The SEO Pack, €25, paid once: 10 more SEO pages, each designed for a specific search made on Google. It cannot be chosen when ordering. The client orders it later, whenever they wish, from their client area (“My requests” tab).

Monthly plans. A client who lets Les Minis Monstres put the website online chooses Peace of Mind, at €10 a month, or Growth, at €20 a month (article 6). Paid yearly, they come with 2 months free.

Website only. A client who prefers to put the website online themselves chooses “I will handle it myself” when ordering: this is the website only option. They then pay only for the creation of the website, €500, and the online shop if they take it, with no monthly plan. They manage their own domain name and hosting, which they may already have. Les Minis Monstres does not provide either of them. Once the website is finished and the rest is paid, or its payment in instalments is set up, Alex hands the client the website’s code: its files and a full backup, with a short installation guide, ready to install with the client’s hosting provider. The client does the installation themselves, or with help from their hosting provider. They can rely on free public guides, such as their hosting provider’s help pages. Maintenance, backups, security and changes are not included. The client can take a plan later.

Quotes. A complete redesign of the website or a new feature, such as appointment booking, is subject to a quote. The client accepts it before work begins.

4. Event offer

A person met by Les Minis Monstres at a fair, a market, a trade show or a business event receives an event code. This code gives a 20% discount on the creation of the website, meaning on the website and on the online shop if it is taken. It does not apply to the monthly plans, nor to the SEO Pack ordered later.

The client enters the code when ordering. The code is checked, and the summary shows the discounted price before payment. The deposit and the rest of the creation price are calculated on this discounted price (article 5).

5. Paying for the build

The build price is paid in two stages.

  • When ordering: a deposit of 25% of the creation price, including the online shop if there is one.
  • When the website is delivered: the rest, in one go.
  • Or, on delivery, in 6 or 12 interest-free instalments: the rest is split into 6 or 12 monthly instalments, as the client chooses. If they have a plan, it is then paid monthly. Each instalment is rounded down to the nearest cent: the total never exceeds the price of the website. The debits stop on their own after the last instalment.

At the time of ordering, the client chooses to pay the rest in one go or in several instalments. This choice is open with a plan as well as with website only (article 3).

Example for a €500 website, without an event code: the client pays €125 when ordering. On delivery, they pay €375 in one go, or €62.50 a month for 6 months, or €31.25 a month for 12 months.

6. Monthly plans

A client who lets Les Minis Monstres put the website online chooses one of the two plans when ordering, along with their domain name. It starts when the website is delivered. It has no commitment (article 8).

Peace of Mind, €10 a month. It includes:

  • Hosting: the website stays available 24 hours a day, with HTTPS, the little padlock that protects exchanges with visitors.
  • The domain name, meaning the website’s address, registered in the client’s name and renewed every year (article 10).
  • Backups: safety copies of the website, made regularly.
  • Security and monitoring: the website is protected, and checked day and night to make sure it works properly.
  • Maintenance: regular technical checks, so the website stays in working order.
  • Changes, included with no limit on their number and put online within 72 hours at most (article 12).
  • The client area, with the help bubble (article 13).

Growth, €20 a month. It includes everything in the Peace of Mind plan, and in addition:

  • Priority handling: the client’s requests go before the others.
  • An average turnaround of 12 to 24 hours for changes (article 12).
  • One extra SEO page every week, prepared by Les Minis Monstres and added to the client’s website.

In the first year, the domain name and hosting are free with the plan, except for a website with an online shop. Installing the website and putting it online are always included (article 3). From the second year, or from going live for a website with a shop, the plan covers them, at no extra cost.

Payment. The plan is charged in advance, every month or every year, as the client chooses. Yearly, the client pays for 10 months out of 12, so 2 months free: €100 a year for Peace of Mind, €200 a year for Growth. The client can switch from monthly to yearly, or from yearly to monthly, at renewal.

Change of plan. The client can switch from one plan to the other from their client area. The new price applies from the next payment date.

Payments are handled by Stripe, the online payment provider, by bank card or by SEPA direct debit, meaning directly from the bank account. Les Minis Monstres does not see and does not keep bank details. Each invoice is sent by email and remains available in the client area.

If a payment fails, the client is notified by email. If nothing is settled within 30 days, the website may be paused until payment.

7. Clients who signed up before 17 November 2026

A client who signed up before 17 November 2026 keeps the options and extras they already have, on the same terms, as long as they do not remove them. They can switch to one of the two plans from their client area.

8. Commitment, cancellation and end of the plan

The plan has no commitment. The client can stop it at any time, by email, by message or with the button provided in their client area. The stop takes effect at the end of the period already paid.

One exception: when the rest of the creation price is paid in instalments, the client commits for the payment period, so 6 or 12 months from delivery of the website. If they stop earlier, the rest of the creation price becomes due in one go. With website only, the monthly payments remain due in the same way until the last one. Once the website is paid for, the plan has no commitment.

The end of the plan ends the hosting of the website by Les Minis Monstres, its upkeep and the changes. The client receives their website as files (texts, images, pages), so they can have it hosted wherever they want. The domain name belongs to them: they can transfer it to the provider of their choice. Hosting by Les Minis Monstres stops 30 days after the end of the plan.

9. Right of withdrawal

A client ordering remotely has 14 days to withdraw, without giving a reason. A message through the contact form (https://www.aled08.fr/en/contact/) is enough.

When ordering, the client expressly requests, by ticking the box provided, that the creation starts straight away. If they withdraw during these 14 days, they pay for the work already done, pro rata to the creation price. The domain name already reserved, the website’s address, remains at their expense, because it is registered in their name and for one year.

10. Domain name

The domain name is the website’s address on the internet. The client is its holder. Les Minis Monstres is listed as the technical contact, so it can manage it. The name is reserved after the first payment, if it is still available at that time.

With a monthly plan, a standard .fr, .com, .net or .org domain name is free for the first year, except for a website with an online shop. After that, its annual renewal is included in the plan. Other extensions and so-called “premium” names, sold at a higher price by the registries (the organisations that manage each extension), are subject to a quote.

If the client already owns a domain name, they can transfer it to Les Minis Monstres or keep it with their provider and point it to the website. Les Minis Monstres sends them the settings to apply. With website only, the client manages their domain name without Les Minis Monstres (article 3).

11. Building the website and timescales

The client provides their texts, photos and information, or prepares them with Les Minis Monstres from their explanations. The stated lead times (a single page: 3 to 5 days, a site with several pages: 1 to 2 weeks, an online shop: 2 to 3 weeks) are indicative. They start once these items have been received. The client sees their website before it goes live and can ask for adjustments to what was ordered.

12. Changes

What is included. Changes are included in both plans, with no limit on their number. A change is an alteration requested on the website: adding or changing text or photos, updating information. Adding a page is also a change, within the limit of the website’s 15 pages. A complete redesign or a new feature, such as appointment booking, is subject to a quote (article 3).

Process. Each change follows the same steps:

  1. The client makes their request in their client area.
  2. Bricou, the builder of the little band (article 15), prepares the change.
  3. A preview is created: an advance view of the changed page, which the client can look at.
  4. Alex receives the proposal and checks it.
  5. If Alex does not refuse it within 30 minutes, the proposal is approved.
  6. The change is put online.

If Bricou cannot prepare the change, Alex makes it by hand.

Timescales. With the Peace of Mind plan, the change is put online within 72 hours at most. With the Growth plan, requests are handled first, with an average turnaround of 12 to 24 hours. A request on quote follows the timescale stated in the quote.

13. Client area and account

A client area is created automatically when ordering, with the client’s email address. It is their personal page, protected by a password. There, they follow their order, their change requests, their plan and their invoices, and they find their referral link. It is also where they order the SEO Pack, in the “My requests” tab. Cerise’s help bubble answers their questions there, up to 40 messages a day. They keep their login details to themselves and notify Les Minis Monstres if they have any doubt about their use.

An account with no login for 12 months and no active plan is deleted automatically, along with its requests and photos. The client is warned by email 30 days before. Logging in once is enough to cancel the deletion. Invoices are kept outside the account, for the period required by law.

14. Content provided by the client

The client guarantees that they have the right to use the text, images, logos and products they provide. They remain responsible for the legal information specific to their business: mandatory notices, the terms of sale of their shop, displayed prices.

15. Versions and automated tools

Each version of the website is saved and can be brought back on request.

Alex designs and builds every website. For repetitive tasks, he relies on automated tools that he programmed himself, presented on the website as a little band of little monsters. With both plans, the band includes:

  • Cerise, the secretary: welcomes requests, organises projects, prepares replies and answers in the help bubble.
  • Bricou, the builder: helps build websites, prepares changes and builds new pages.
  • Plume, the writer: prepares content, helps write texts and makes them easier to read.
  • Mochi, the organiser: sorts the content and organises the pages.
  • Pistache, the guardian: makes the backups and does the maintenance, looks after security and monitors the website.
  • Mirette, the observer: tracks the website’s statistics and performance, and spots what can be improved.
  • Lumi, the Google star: prepares the SEO pages.

Champi, the seller, comes with the online shop: he keeps the catalogue in order, tracks orders and sends emails to buyers. In this article, “the little monsters” means all of these tools, the help bubble included.

The little monsters are automated tools, some of which rely on an artificial intelligence system, and they can make mistakes. Alex checks every proposed change before it goes online (article 12). The texts and advice given by the tools are suggestions: the client reads them over and remains responsible for what they publish. These tools do not give legal, medical or accounting advice.

16. SEO

Search engine optimisation, or SEO, is the work that helps a website be found on Google. Basic Google SEO is included in the creation of the website. SEO pages (article 3), the SEO Pack ordered from the client area and the page added every week with the Growth plan strengthen the website’s presence on Google.

In all cases, SEO is an obligation of means: Les Minis Monstres does its best and applies good practice, without guaranteeing any given position on Google.

17. Referral and loyalty

Each client has a referral link and a referral code in their client area. When a referred client’s website is online, the referrer and the referred client each receive one free month on their plan, credited on the next invoice. A second website ordered by the same client receives a 10% discount on its creation. These benefits cannot be exchanged for cash.

18. Liability

Les Minis Monstres does everything possible to keep the website available and backed up. Les Minis Monstres cannot be held responsible for an outage of the host (the company that keeps the website online), of a domain name registry or of the payment service, nor for content provided by the client. Any compensation cannot exceed the sums paid for the plan over the last 12 months, unless the law provides otherwise.

19. Mediation and disputes

In case of disagreement, the client first writes through the contact form (https://www.aled08.fr/en/contact/): most questions are settled in a few exchanges. If the answer does not suit them, a consumer client can refer the matter free of charge to a consumer mediator: one is being appointed, and their details will be given here. French law applies.

Last updated: 17 November 2026.
